entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
My VeloBand Cadence Sensor is not working. I'd like to return it.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's broken. It won't sync with my app. It's basically just a useless piece of plastic.
I see. It sounds frustrating when a device won't sync up properly. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account to pull up your details?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I'm just checking our return eligibility for you now.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see here that your item was delivered 37 days ago. Our policy allows for returns of items in their original condition within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can go ahead and process a full refund for this defective item right away.
Oh. I didn't expect that. Fine, that works I guess.

Excellent. And because you're a VIP member and had to deal with this inconvenience, I'm also adding a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase. I've just initiated the return; you'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes. Just box it up and drop it off.
Okay. That's actually helpful. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
